items.title: Ocean View Suite
items.description: Our Ocean View Suite is designed for the height of luxury and relaxation, with panoramic ocean views. Sleeps up to two guests.

items.title: Presidential Suite
items.description: With two queen beds, the Presidential Suite is our finest accommodation with premium amenities. Sleeps up to four guests.

items.title: Garden Deluxe Room
items.description: Our Garden Deluxe Room is designed for economy without sacrificing the comforts of our luxury amenities. With peaceful views of our tropical gardens, this room sleeps up to two guests.

items.title: Resort Style Pool
items.description: Our outdoor pool and hot tub will help you relax after a long day, whether you spent it exploring the local area or hard at work. The pool is heated to be comfortable year-round. Open 7 AM to 10 PM.
